rationale: Builds directly on the current late-aligned recurrent-tail best, but spends the early wallclock budget on a cheaper one-block tail recurrence before switching back to the full two-block tail for the quant-aware endgame and final exact int8 evaluation. title: Staged Tail-Recurrence Depth Schedule
